name: MyDemoTicket
description: Create, update and ingest tickets of the MyDemoTicket demo ticket system

base_url.description: Base URL of the ticket system (e.g. https://ticket.soc-games.com)

source_tag.description: Value of the X-MyDemoTicket-Source header (loop prevention)

ingest_label.description: Label for containers created by on poll

poll_state_filter.description: Only poll tickets in this state (optional)

actions.description: Validate the asset configuration (GET /health and GET /me, role integration/agent/admin)
actions.verbose: Validate the asset configuration (GET /health and GET /me, role integration/agent/admin)

actions.description: Create a ticket; the current SOAR container ID is stored in external_refs.soar_container_id
actions.verbose: Create a ticket; the current SOAR container ID is stored in external_refs.soar_container_id

custom_fields.description: Custom fields as JSON object string, e.g. {"mitre_tactic": "TA0001"}

es_finding_id.description: Splunk ES finding/notable event ID (stored in external_refs)

actions.description: Update ticket fields (all optional, custom_fields merged)
actions.verbose: Update ticket fields (all optional, custom_fields merged)

custom_fields.description: Custom fields as JSON object string (merged)

es_finding_id.description: Splunk ES finding/notable event ID (merged into external_refs)

actions.description: Change the state of a ticket
actions.verbose: Change the state of a ticket

actions.description: Add a comment or work note to a ticket
actions.verbose: Add a comment or work note to a ticket

updated_since.description: Only tickets updated since (ISO-8601 UTC, e.g. 2026-11-24T10:00:00Z)

actions.description: Get the journal (history, comments, work notes) of a ticket
actions.verbose: Get the journal (history, comments, work notes) of a ticket

actions.description: Ingest tickets updated since the last poll as containers (source_data_identifier = ticket number) with a 'ticket snapshot' artifact
actions.verbose: Ingest tickets updated since the last poll as containers (source_data_identifier = ticket number) with a 'ticket snapshot' artifact

container_count.description: Maximum number of tickets to ingest during Poll Now
